decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks align with existing dental-lab channels and remain a low-cost option with unresolved upside.
PETG thermoforming blanks support the firm's move into digital manufacturing and have strategic option value.
UV-curing lacquer is a lower-profile materials option with unresolved potential but less website prominence, so drop risk is moderate.
Custom hearing-protection earmolds fit the hearing-care segment and have survived initial screening, but their fit with digital manufacturing is less certain.
